name: researchflow-backend
description: ResearchFlow Backend: Firebase Auth, Firestore Metadata Check, and Cloudinary Dynamic Watermark Service

scripts.clean-port: powershell -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Host 'Port 5000 freed' } else { Write-Host 'Port 5000 already free' }"
